sources.facts: ISO200, daylight, C41; natural colour, good contrast, greens/reds and skin. No sensitometric curves supplied.
ISO400 C41; greens, desaturated shadows, pronounced grain.
ISO400/27, daylight C41 curves, no remjet. Curves NOT digitized; spectral dye/scan calibration unavailable.

Original Phoenix 200, Sep 2024 technical information: ISO200 daylight, C41, high contrast, no masking dyes and limited antihalation. Not Phoenix II. Characteristic chart is not a calibrated positive RGB LUT; numeric design below is authored.

No same-stock manufacturer digital LUT or sensitometric publication located in the official Kodak/Alaris indexes on 2026-11-02. This is an independent ColorPlus-inspired design, not Gold 200, VR200 or a renamed Kodacolor substitute. Official colour-data requirement remains unmet for this stock.

Fujifilm NATURA1600 bulletin 013AR313B: ISO1600 daylight, neutral grey balance, faithful colours and fourth colour-sensitive layer. Vendored MIT Natura1600 digitization; display inversion and spectral reconstruction are model assumptions.
Official Redscale XR launch: ISO50-200, C41. ISO200 gives intense red/orange; lower ISO can introduce blue/green. This single look targets the ISO200 direction, not the entire exposure range.

Manufacturer Agfa F-AF-E6 standard-film brochure, archived copy: original Vista200, ISO200 daylight5500K, AP70/C41, EYE VISION colour fidelity. No substitution of Vista100 or later AgfaPhoto Vista Plus/Fuji C200. Numerical display model is authored, curves not digitized.
